$comment: Descriptor for adding accountable-surface as a Flywheel lane. Maps to the Lane dataclass in flywheel harness/lanes_registry.py. A maintainer pastes the ready-to-use Lane(...) line from interop/README.md into the LANES registry; this file is the data behind it. The lane roster marks a lane live when its {name}.status health tool answers -- this server advertises accountable-surface.status.
name: accountable-surface
role: accountable actuation: gate + independent verify + rollback + offline-re-derivable receipt over MCP
note: The protocol layer is stdlib only (no FastMCP). status/doctor answer without the action runtime, so the roster can mark the lane live; the action tools load the runtime (coherence-membrane + proof-surface) lazily.
